discrepancies.reference_text: मुझे सेक्स में इंटरेस्ट नहीं है
discrepancies.hypothesis_text: मुझे सिर्फ कुछ नहीं इंटरेस्ट नहीं है
discrepancies.explanation: The hypothesis garbles the negation and meaning of the statement.
The hypothesis changes the meaning to a derogatory slur.
The hypothesis changes the word 'body' (implied) to a word meaning 'discount/exemption'.
